I replied to Hollis in a thread under his message in #central-team. The only deadline we have for the signed order form at Tansley Parcel is 25 August, which Pree posted in that channel on 14 October. It hasn't been confirmed. That date had already passed when she posted it, so I'd asked her whether she meant next year or made a typo. She hasn't answered.

I told Hollis not to put it in the account sheet until she confirms, and asked Pree in the same thread to say which date is right. I couldn't check it against anything else because I can't find any Tansley Parcel account files in the share.
